proposed_widenings.name: AreaSaveGateOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Insect Plague's persistent damage is delivered via a save gate that fires when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit variants; neither encodes a save gate triggered by area interaction. A new SaveGateOnAreaInteractionOperation variant is needed with: ability, dc, onFail effect, onSuccess effect, and a trigger kind (enters_or_ends_turn). All required v4 atoms (save_gate, area, damage, persist/expire) already exist.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

notes: Honest structural fit is ongoing_effect: concentration duration, area attachment (sphere 20-ft radius, point_within_range origin), slot-scaled damage (+1d10 per slot above 5). All v4 atoms needed are present. Only OngoingOperation lacks a save_gate variant. Secondary gap: the 'initial burst' (save fires for all creatures in the area when the swarm first appears) is the same save gate but triggered at cast time rather than on entry/end-of-turn; this could be folded into the same operation with an 'also_on_appear' flag, or expressed as an activation phase followed by an ongoing_effect — but the combined-family composition has no surface support either. Terrain/visibility effects (Lightly Obscured, Difficult Terrain) are caller-owned environmental state per ARCHITECTURE.md and are excluded from the core mechanics encoding.
